prompt.title: Prompt
paragraphs: You are supporting the {{audience}} with a weekly business review.
Summarize the main result, one risk, and one action in a {{responseMode}} update that is easy for non-technical stakeholders to use.
Use plain language and keep recommendations directly tied to decisions.
checklist: State the top outcome with one metric.
Highlight one operational risk with why it matters.
Provide one next action with clear ownership.
Prefer concise wording when possible to reduce unnecessary output length.

events.content: Preparing responsible AI review for the {{audience}}...
Analyzing weekly KPIs and management notes in {{responseMode}} mode...
Top result: revenue increased 7.3% week over week, showing continued demand momentum for the {{audience}}.
Primary risk: refund rate increased to 2.1%, which can reduce margin if root causes are not addressed quickly.
Methodology note: token usage is estimated from visible prompt/output text, and environmental values are shown as reference profile estimates.
Efficiency insight: asking for a concise answer can lower output-token usage while preserving decision quality.
